name: What ventilation capacity (CFM) do I need for my range hood?

mainEntity.name: What ventilation capacity (CFM) do I need for my range hood?

acceptedAnswer.text: Determining the correct ventilation capacity (CFM, or cubic feet per minute) for your range hood is crucial for effective fume removal. A general guideline is to have at least 100 CFM for every 10,000 BTUs of stove burner output, or 1 CFM per square foot of kitchen space for general ventilation. We evaluate your specific cooking needs and appliance specifications during the design phase of your kitchen remodel to recommend a hood with appropriate CFM, ensuring optimal air quality and performance in your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Calculate range hood CFM based on stove BTU output (100 CFM per 10,000 BTU) or kitchen size (1 CFM per square foot) to ensure effective ventilation.
